other.general.title: Vague general dissatisfaction without specifics
other.general.description: Reviewers express broad frustration with the app, often tied to free-tier limits, feature access, or wanting parity with other platforms.

usability.ads-interruptions.title: Excessive irrelevant ads for free users
usability.ads-interruptions.description: Free users say ads are frequent, annoying and irrelevant, and feel forced to listen to them because they cannot afford premium.

billing.premium-paywall-features.title: Basic features moved behind premium paywall
billing.premium-paywall-features.description: Users say core features such as lyrics, loop, previous track, and queue are now locked behind a premium subscription, which they see as unfair.

usability.shuffle-playback-control.title: Shuffle, skip and rewind removed
usability.shuffle-playback-control.description: Customers report that shuffle, loop, unlimited skips, rewinding and playing specific parts of songs were removed or restricted after an update.

playback.general.title: Audio glitches, hangs and quality drops
playback.general.description: Users describe songs skipping or dropping in quality, the app hanging, and offline or downloaded playback behaving unreliably.

usability.general.title: Updates make app hard to navigate
usability.general.description: Reviewers say recent updates made it harder to select songs, sort lists, and move around, and that each update seems to worsen navigation.

playback.playback-stops-crashes.title: Songs stop playing and app crashes
playback.playback-stops-crashes.description: Customers report that songs stop unexpectedly and cannot be replayed, playlists fail to load, and the app goes dead or crashes after updates.

usability.interface-layout-changes.title: Redesigned layout removes familiar features
usability.interface-layout-changes.description: Users say redesigns removed quick links, playlist visibility, recently played access, and queue or sorting options they relied on.

access.general.title: Playback errors and crashes after updates
access.general.description: Users report playback failure errors, random crashes, and content not loading, saying the app worked well before recent updates.

billing.charges-cancellation.title: Charged without warning, features unusable
billing.charges-cancellation.description: Subscribers say they are charged without reminders, and that paid accounts cannot use downloaded music offline or get the benefits they paid for.

catalog.songs-missing-removed.title: Songs unavailable or removed from catalog
catalog.songs-missing-removed.description: Users report that favorite songs, albums, and regional music such as Bollywood tracks disappear or show as unavailable, even after reinstalling.

billing.general.title: Paid tier lacks value
billing.general.description: Users feel the paid plan is not worth it, citing paywalled basics, missing songs, and ads even for paying members.

catalog.lyrics-missing.title: Lyrics missing or fail to load
catalog.lyrics-missing.description: Users say lyrics are never shown, show a couldn't load message, or are incorrect or absent for most songs, despite updates.

catalog.general.title: Songs greyed out, albums fail to load
catalog.general.description: Users report songs greyed out and unplayable, liked songs and artist albums not loading, and general dissatisfaction with recent updates.

catalog.recommendations-autoplay.title: Shuffle and recommendations feel stale
catalog.recommendations-autoplay.description: Users say recommendations and autoplay repeat the same songs, do not match their taste, and that smart shuffle adds tracks they cannot track.

access.phone-number-login.title: Login fails and app logs out
access.phone-number-login.description: Users report the app repeatedly logs them out and rejects login details, making account changes difficult and blocking phone-based access.

access.password-social-login.title: Google and phone login failures
access.password-social-login.description: Users report that single sign-on through Google fails, phone-number login stops working, and songs gray out with a false no-connection message.

billing.subscription-price.title: Premium price too high
billing.subscription-price.description: Users find the premium subscription too expensive for their budget, especially in regions without a free ad-supported tier, and feel ads remain intrusive.

playback.offline-false-errors.title: False no-internet errors despite connection
playback.offline-false-errors.description: Users say the app shows a no internet connection error while they are connected, and that now-playing controls or rewinding disappear.

catalog.unwanted-songs-added.title: Random songs added to playlists
catalog.unwanted-songs-added.description: Users find unwanted tracks appearing in their own playlists, including other people's songs, and playback jumping to songs they do not want to hear.

access.account-session-signup.title: Session and playlist access failures
access.account-session-signup.description: Users report being logged out and losing downloads, being unable to add songs to playlists, and restrictions on choosing or liking particular songs.

playback.bluetooth-device-control.title: Bluetooth connection and queue control issues
playback.bluetooth-device-control.description: Users report Bluetooth headsets and car connections drop or behave oddly, and they cannot control track selection or queues from connected devices.

access.app-wont-open.title: App fails to open or log in
access.app-wont-open.description: Users say the app won't open, shows nothing loading, or claims there is no internet even when connected, even after reinstalling.

playback.buffering-slow-loading.title: Laggy app and slow loading
playback.buffering-slow-loading.description: Users describe the app as very laggy and slow, with music pausing for seconds and network-related loading problems not seen in other apps.

downloads.downloads-deleted.title: Downloads removed unexpectedly after logout
downloads.downloads-deleted.description: Users say downloaded songs and playlists are deleted automatically, often after logout or over time, forcing them to re-download music.

downloads.downloads-fail-to-save.title: Downloads fail to save or sync
downloads.downloads-fail-to-save.description: Users report that songs only download when clicked, that SD card transfers fail, and that reinstalling does not fix repeated download failures.

downloads.offline-playback-needs-network.title: Offline playback fails without network
downloads.offline-playback-needs-network.description: Users say downloaded playlists and songs won't play offline, and the app hangs searching for them, which is frustrating on long drives or without signal.

downloads.general.title: Downloaded and liked songs fail to load
downloads.general.description: Users report downloaded songs loading slowly, liked songs disappearing, and playlists stuck syncing before going offline.

catalog.content-bias-policy.title: Music removals over political content
catalog.content-bias-policy.description: Users object to Spotify removing music or artists, and accuse it of political censorship, which leads some to say they will leave the service.

support.support-response-quality.title: Support gives unhelpful, slow responses
support.support-response-quality.description: Users say support emails go unanswered, and that suggested fixes like reinstalling fail to solve persistent bugs reported long ago.

support.general.title: Vague frustration with company and pricing
support.general.description: Users express general discontent with the company, its pricing, and its artist payouts, and say they will stop using or subscribing to the service.

support.support-channels-broken.title: Support contact channels unavailable or broken
support.support-channels-broken.description: Users report customer service has no phone line, limits help to text or chat, and that in-app support website links are broken.
